mapper.sql: FROM ai_hr_matching_result r JOIN ai_hr_candidate c ON c.id=r.candidate_id AND c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id JOIN ai_hr_position p ON p.id=r.position_id AND p.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND c.expires_at > #{now} AND c.department_id IN #{d} AND p.department_id IN #{d} AND r.position_id IN #{pid} AND r.candidate_id IN #{cid} AND ((#{g.permission}='hr:candidate:read' AND c.department_id=#{g.departmentId} AND (#{g.candidateId}='*' OR c.id=#{g.candidateId}))) AND ((#{g.permission}='hr:position:read' AND p.department_id=#{g.departmentId} AND (#{g.positionId}='*' OR p.id=#{g.positionId}))) AND ((#{g.permission}='hr:matching:read' AND p.department_id=#{g.departmentId} AND (#{g.positionId}='*' OR p.id=#{g.positionId})))AND r.position_id=#{positionId}AND r.candidate_id=#{candidateId}AND r.config_version=#{configVersion}AND r.status=#{businessStatus}AND r.status='CURRENT'AND r.business_status=#{businessStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.tenant_id,r.candidate_id,r.position_id,r.fact_snapshot_id,r.config_version,r.context_version,r.semantic_snapshot_id,r.result_json,r.status,r.superseded_by,r.created_at,r.business_status,r.total_score,r.evidence_coverage,r.band ORDER BY r.total_score DESC,r.evidence_coverage DESC,r.created_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
